mission: LÉLU 2.2.2 — global state and cache audit
method: grep for module-level mutable maps, singletons, static registries, shared arrays and caches in src/core, src/brain, src/app; each hit classified as shared-by-design, shared-but-scoped, or removed

components.shared_because: one persistent self-representation for the installation
components.data: identity, capabilities, knows, goals, projects, discoveries
components.access: every snapshot; project NAMES filtered per scope
components.authorization: durable self-knowledge only; no conversation content
components.invalidation: KvStore persistence; edited by the cognitive loop

components.access: list(), then isProjectVisible / decideProject per turn
components.authorization: ownership + scope + originating conversation, labelled when foreign
components.isolation: filtered at every read; no cached lists handed to callers

components.authorization: definitions are operational; an agent's task content is scoped by the runner (M22.1)
components.isolation: per-task scope passed to toolContext and delegate

components.shared_because: one execution stream for UI and cognition
components.access: recent(n) — filtered by ownerForTask per snapshot
components.authorization: event ownership; ownerless events are no longer rendered
components.isolation: ownerForTask(taskId) is set when the task is created

components.shared_because: all conversations live in one store
components.access: by id; the shared conversation window is scoped per conversation (M22.1)

components.shared_because: one embodied runtime state (mode, task, avatar, UI)
components.data: current mode/task/action, approvals, last verified action
components.authorization: last action shown only to its owning conversation
components.isolation: concurrent conversations may interleave currentAction; it carries no conversation content after 2.2.2

components.shared_because: one decision log for UI and debugging

components.data: UI layout, capability status, errors, proposals

removed_or_narrowed: Workspace.items: string[] — replaced by scoped observations
buildCognitiveContext() global default — now requires a scope for conversation-derived content
Unscoped recent execution events — ownerless events excluded
Executive last action rendered globally — now conversation-scoped
not_eliminated: shared singletons that hold durable or operational state were kept; only their unauthorized CONTENT was removed. No duplicate memory system was introduced.
